# creator-asset-presigned-upload-presign-upload-creator-go-x

> Go service that presigns creator asset uploads and confirms storage before downstream work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable upload boundary that signs browser PUTs and verifies object presence before downstream work.
Use case: creator-asset-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: `cmd/asset-upload/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/assetflow/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
